Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

naxp 0.2.0

  • is.na() and anyNA() report an encoded value of 0 as missing in a naxp_encoded vector. The stored value is still 0, so as.numeric(), complete.cases() and functions built on vctrs, such as tidyr::drop_na(), still see 0.
  • Assigning NA into a naxp_encoded vector stores 0, so x[i] <- NA and is.na(x) <- i work.
  • Indexing a naxp_encoded vector out of range or with NA gives 0, not NA.

naxp 0.1.0

CRAN release: 2026-11-03

Initial CRAN release. It wraps the naxp C++ library 0.15.0.

  • naxp_parse() parses a naxp’s pattern, raising a naxp_error with the error’s code, message, offset and length where the pattern is invalid.
  • naxp_standard() and naxp_standards() return the standard naxps built into every naxp library.
  • naxp_encode() and naxp_decode() convert between text and encoded values. Invalid text encodes to 0, never NA.
  • naxp_accepts() and naxp_canonical_form() check text without encoding it.
  • naxp_encoded vectors
    • retain their naxp as an attribute,
    • print as decoded text, with 0 shown as <invalid (0)>,
    • support == and !=, subsetting, c(), rep(), unique(), sort() and match(), and
    • can be used as columns in a data frame or tibble.
  • naxp_encoded() creates a naxp_encoded vector from a numeric vector and a naxp.
  • naxp_pattern(), naxp_max_encoded_value() and naxp_max_length() report a naxp’s properties.
  • Every function that takes a naxp parameter can instead take in its place
    • a naxp pattern string, parsed as a naxp, or
    • a naxp_encoded vector, whose naxp is used.
  • naxp_compare() and naxp_first_divergent_value() compare two naxps.
  • naxp_emit() generates source code for a naxp in any of the languages C, C++, C# or JavaScript.
